description: Viewport breakpoints (Framer layout variants) and container-query breakpoints (per-component, since each code component uses container-type: inline-size). All widths are real, measured CSS px.

below-desktop.note: tablet + phone combined, used for nav hamburger / stacked hero / logos tablet-phone layout

playbooks.note: at 1280 the page already uses Tablet variant (hamburger nav) unlike homepage

pricing.note: 1440 and 1280 render the same Desktop variant; nav component itself still switches at 1200/810

1800.appliesTo: section frames of jobs, showcase, pricing, and the who-it-fits group (team-fit, wall-of-love, pricing)

1360.appliesTo: main content width: hero row desktop, logos title/container desktop, stories container, .vstack (jobs), showcase root, team-fit root, pricing container, .vstack-inner, .vcc-scene

vstack-jobs.firesAtViewport: 1100c: vw<=1156; 760c: vw 810-816 tablet and vw<=800 phone (quirk, see spec/GRID.md 7.1)

quirks.jobsAt801to816: At 810-816 the tablet gutter of 28 makes container 754-760, jobs is stacked (not pinned, height 1803.5). At 801-809 the phone gutter of 20 makes it 761-769, jobs has 4 columns and IS pinned (height 2846). Reproduce, do not fix.
quirks.heroLogosAt1156to1199: The tablet 1100 cap engages, content starts at (vw-1100)/2 instead of 28.
quirks.teamFitAt1376: Uses the large shell (60/64/64 padding, 72 gap). At 1366 uses the medium one.
quirks.vgsGutterHeldTo721: vgs sections (steps/integrations/wall-of-love) keep a 48px gutter down to 721px, unlike Framer sections which drop to 28/20.
